answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a sinkable bond: any address wanting a grading seat locks collateral scaled to its weight, refunded at settlement only if its work grades correct, burned outright on collusion or cloned keys. Minting extra addresses still pulls a fresh bond from the same pocket, so ten percent of seats costs ten times one seat. The curve hits its vertex where bond outlay exceeds reward per extra identity, past which a bigger swarm only deepens the loss. From dawn to settlement honest stake returns; the attacker pays again each epoch and keeps no pearl of influence.
